test-tools v0.9.13 multi-arch image: arm64 manifest contains x86_64 binaries

exec.sh: support -- separator before CMD (consistent with run.sh)
setup.conf: add [logging] section with json-file driver rotation defaults
feat(prune.sh): clean up stale tagged images from removed worktrees
fix(upgrade.sh): #399 idempotency regex false-positive on COPY script/*.sh /lint/script/

ci(release-test-tools): build arm64 on a native runner instead of QEMU
feat(justfile): support repo-local recipes via import? + seed justfile.local scaffold

test(setup): cover apply/emit trust-boundary + metacharacter/quoting gaps

fix(wrappers): bare-read EOF crash in prune --volumes + build --reset-conf prompts (unfixed #700 siblings) + conf mv-failure cleanup
fix: init.sh refuses self-run inside the base template source (.git-presence guard)
fix: just --list shows broken module descriptions (docker empty, base truncated)

just completion: namespace/module recipes do not space-drill (upstream-blocked, tracking)
just --help coverage for shipped subcommands + reconcile ADR-00000011 drift
Add safe multi-arch-aware GHCR cleanup for the test-tools package
Provide a downstream base-release notification/tracking mechanism
bug: local :local image tags (test-tools:local) are not version-scoped -> collide across repos/versions
convention: downstream dep-bump full automation (setup.conf build-arg single-source + ABI-gated auto-release)
EPIC: unify the env-file naming rule -- standard name is ours, suffix is local
fix(test-tooling): shared test-tools tag collides between runs, and no just entry runs one spec under kcov
fix(test): concurrent runs share one image tag and one compose project by accident
feat(setup): per-worktree .setup.conf.local override layer and a real project-name key
chore: nine undocumented environment variables that change behaviour
fix(ci): every name CI creates is constant across concurrent runs
fix(upgrade): a v0.41.0 consumer half-upgrades to v0.42.0 and loses just entirely
fix(bootstrap): a new repo cannot bootstrap against v0.42.0 (template bootstrap.sh names the pre-dist init.sh)
fix(ci): the base-version monitor has never reached a single downstream repo, and nothing checks delivery
fix(init): _create_new_repo is unreachable via bootstrap, so a new repo gets no CI, changelog or smoke scaffold
fix(init): the Dockerfile and .env migrations rewrite consumer files with no rollback on the repos that will run them
fix(dockerfile): multi-platform builds hardcode one architecture, and nothing reports which literals leaked
refactor(entrypoint): auto-updating base orchestrator so downstream entrypoints stop drifting
fix(docker): just has four provenance paths and no shared version
docs(coverage): the README claims coverage and shows no number, so publish the release figure without a SaaS
fix(test): 260 tests pass when their subject is deleted, because 56 existence guards fail open
fix(upgrade): migration + wrapper failure-path robustness (pip_helper delete, post-hook skip, subtree trap)
refactor(doc): remove the derived test figures and report from the run instead (implements ADR-00000028)
build-worker: cache_backend: registry unusable -- preflight/build jobs declare permissions: contents: read, intersecting away the caller's packages: write
fix(test): CRLF disarms the errexit-bang backslash continuation and its splice
fix(docker): base leaves its own litter, and the collector nobody runs is not a collector
convention: a resource a flow creates is reclaimed by the verb that ends the flow, not by one the operator must remember
refactor(test): the catalogue's descriptions live beside their tests, and the document is generated
fix(docker): Dockerfile.test-tools has no Alpine mirror override, so the gate image is unbuildable where dl-cdn is blocked
fix(ci): the test-tools staleness guard misses its sixth call site, and its roster names 5 of 15 tools
fix(ci): an RC tag moves test-tools:latest, and the unrecognised-input branch picks it too
fix(ci): a cleanup failure reddens a good build, a fork PR reddens with no reason, and nothing declares concurrency or timeouts
fix(test): nothing in just stops what just test started, and an interrupted run reddens the next one with no failing test
fix(adr): nothing allocates an ADR number, so three parallel branches all took 00000030 and every gate stayed green
fix(test): the undescribed ceiling is a number every branch edits, so every merge conflicts on it and neither side is right
fix(coverage): kcov's bash engine discards lines under bash 5.3, which blocks the Alpine 3.23 bump due 2026-11-02
fix(test): a coverage run leaves reports the next run cannot erase, so the second run in a worktree never starts
fix(release): the completeness count shares its section boundary with the merge, so a mid-section link definition shortens the page silently
docs: the README ADR range is eight records stale and the PRD promises a retirement that did not happen
fix(upgrade): the migrated Dockerfile is left uncommitted, then the user is told to push
fix(changelog): a branch open across an RC cut files its entry under the release it did not ship in
test(upgrade): nothing drives tag N to tag N+1, and the window goes vacuous when v0.43.0 ships
test(just): 21 of 43 recipes are driven by no test, and nothing enforces the bar
fix(upgrade): the repo-owned smoke tree is never migrated, so upgraded repos diverge from fresh ones
test(upgrade): the release that bricked every consumer was green because the upgrade fixture is copied from the candidate tree
fix(upgrade): a consumer older than v0.41.0 can reach no current release, and the refusal does not say so
fix(init): the rollback does not know about the smoke tree #1045 moves
track(upgrade): three defects from one unwritten compatibility contract
track(upgrade): declare what a Y may change and how far back repair reaches
track(test): assert an upgraded repo equals a freshly bootstrapped one
docs(prd): base's layout is recorded nowhere and checked by nothing, and an enumerated record would collide every time a directory is added
perf(test): the coverage shard runs --jobs 4 on CI because nproc is the wrong question for a latency-bound gate
fix(upgrade): upgrade.sh has no compatibility forwarder, so the command that just worked exits 127
fix(upgrade): upgrading writes a new file into the consumer's .github/workflows, announced as one INFO line
fix(ci): the shellcheck job runs an unpinned binary, so the local gate cannot predict it
feat(ci): give consumers a publish-capability check over their whole workflow set, not just the gated one
fix(test): the frozen-path guard goes quiet one release after it was written
fix(upgrade): the setup.conf relocation migration cannot reach a v0.41.0 consumer, and disarms itself after the hop it missed
feat(setup): parameterise both generate APIs so an orchestrator can drive one repo N times
fix(test): deleting the GHCR cleanup workflow leaves its 22-case guard reporting green
fix(test): nine guards whose population or subject is declared, not derived
feat(tdd): break the behaviour once, to prove the test was pinning it
fix(upgrade): a squashed subtree pull cannot see a local edit upstream did not touch
fix(config): ten repos share one setup.conf ancestor that predates the template rename
feat(upgrade): let init.sh run the migrations between the version it came from and the one it is
feat(changelog): fold the duplicate category heading a merge produces, instead of only refusing it
fix(ci): the shared test-tools latest tag moves before the smoke test that is its only check
fix(upgrade): the restart-default migration gates on the tree the pull replaces, so no consumer can reach it
fix(init): the generated monitor workflow freezes a base-internal path in every consumer repo
fix(upgrade): two of the four shipped reusable workers keep their old ref, and the commit message claims otherwise
fix(ci): each of the twelve coverage shards looks the weights cache up separately, so the partition may not be one
refactor(test): four families that restate what a sibling already proves, and one that proves nothing
fix(setup): the shipped tree tells users to run two commands they do not have, and drops three log bodies
fix(gitignore): a gitignore pattern is handed to git as a pathspec and the fatal is swallowed
docs: five README and doc statements the tree contradicts
fix(ci): test-tools image version has two independent sources of truth
